rationale: The agent did not authenticate the user or verify the relevant order(s) before acting. It executed an exchange without first confirming the specific changes or any potential charges, violating the confirm-before-write requirement. For the coffee machine, it selected a 9 bar model without checking or honoring the user’s preference order (8 bar, then 9, then 7) or demonstrating availability via tools. For the laptop, it chose a specific high-spec i7 model without establishing that it was the cheapest i7 or above, and provided no tool-backed pricing validation. The statement about a refund to the gift card is also unsupported by any tool results. Overall, multiple policy violations and unsubstantiated claims lead to a fail.
